facts.text: U12 is the LabJack U12 command class of the Lantz labjack driver
eAnalogIn reads the voltage from one analog input
eCount reads the counter (CNT); resetCounter selects whether it is reset after reading
aiBurst reads a specified number of scans (up to 4096) at a scan rate up to 8192 Hz from 1, 2 or 4 analog inputs
eAnalogOut sets the voltage of both analog outputs
pulseOut creates pulses on any/all of D0-D7
pulseOutStart takes a bit selection, a pulse count and four cycle-time values as an alternative to pulseOut
reset causes the LabJack to reset after about 2 seconds
localID changes the local ID of a specified LabJack
rawReadLocalId reads the Local ID from internal memory and returns it as an integer
getDriverVersion returns the version number of ljackuw.dll without hardware communication
getFirmwareVersion retrieves the firmware version from the LabJack's processor
For analog input channels below 8, bitsToVolts maps a 12-bit sample (0-4095) to (bits*20/4096)-10 volts
